narrative.details:
You have been so very kind to me, adventurer.  I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week.  Thank you.  I won't be sad about what's happened to me - my parents always told me to rise above anything bad that happens.  I'll be a hero... just like you.

I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home.  Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!
narrative.objectives: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.
narrative.offerRewardText:
May the spirits bless you, adventurer. You've done more for Grunth than most would ever think of doing for him. Thank you - you're the epitome of what it means to be a hero of the Horde.

Please - if you can spare the time, come back and visit us. I know that Grunth would like that, as would I.
narrative.requestItemsText: It is a pleasure to see you again, adventurer. Have you attended to the duties you've volunteered for during Children's Week?
